pages.text: $(#FF69B4)Mouflet$() is the one and only neko boss in the toNeko world. She's $(#FF69B4)twice the size$() of a normal neko, with powerful combat abilities and unique skill mechanics.$(br2)Defeating her — or even better, taming her — is one of the most thrilling challenges in your neko adventure!

pages.title: Base Stats
pages.text: Mouflet's stat panel:$(br2)$(li)$(#FF69B4)Health$(): 100 HP$(li)$(#FF69B4)Armor$(): 10 points$(li)$(#FF69B4)Attack$(): 10 points$(li)$(#FF69B4)Neko Energy$(): 5000 points$(li)$(#FF69B4)Size$(): twice that of a normal neko$(li)$(#FF69B4)Safe Fall$(): 50 blocks$(br2)She appears with a Boss bar visible to all players within 32 blocks.$(br2)She spawns with full diamond armor + either a diamond sword or bazooka with ammo — far beyond any ordinary neko.

pages.title: Important Note
pages.text: $(#FF69B4)Mouflet Boss is still under development and does not naturally spawn in the world.$()$(br2)If you want to challenge her, you'll need to summon her manually via commands.$(br2)Although still in development, her combat mechanics are already quite complete — from skills and defensive counterattacks, to the desperate self-destruct and post-taming pet mode — every part is worth experiencing.$(br2)$(#FFB6C1)Do your homework now, and you'll be the most knowledgeable player when the boss officially launches!$()
